S73 - CONSENT LIMITED TO THAT OF ORIGINAL PERMISSION:  The development hereby permitted shall be begun not later than the expiration of [expiry date of original permission].

REASON: To ensure the commencement timescale for the development is not extended beyond that of the original planning permission granted on [xxx] [LBI ref: [xxx].    Furthermore, to comply with the provisions of Section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 as amended by the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 (Chapter 5).
description: 2.	Section 73 application for the variation of Condition 2 (Approved Plans) of Planning Permission Ref: P2025/0313/FUL dated 25 September 2025 approved for: Demolition of existing mansard roof extension and replacement with a part 4th and 5th floor roof extension to provide additional hotel accommodation, and refurbishment and reconfiguration of an existing hotel and public house (Sui Generis).  The proposed variations to the approved plans include internal alterations and layout changes, resulting in an increase in room sizes, a reduction in the total number of hotel rooms from 34 to 28, the provision of wheelchair refuge accommodation, relocation of cycle store from ground floor to basement, removal of basement home cinema space and improved access to basement public house WCs.
